title: Rusty Refinery

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Turns raw ores into refined ores

body:
"Used for processing ores into refined material!"

Description

The Rusty Refinery is the first obtainable tier of refineries. It can be found and purchased at The Oak Depot, in the basement. It is used to smelt raw ores/rocks into refined ores/rocks by putting them through its conveyor. Some ores/rocks will not fit through, so a Rusty, Steel, or Refined Chisel may be needed.

The description says: Used for processing ores into refined material!

Appearance

A rusty and damaged refinery that has holes boarded up by wood and metal.

Trivia

  • This is the smallest and cheapest refinery in-game.
  • If an object blocking the output, it will not produce (same with forgers and plankers).
    • During blockage it will save entered materials (the amount of them is shown in stat info menu), after removing blockage it will produce all queued materials from first entered to last entered.
